title: Reducing rebuild work in a list

concepts.description: A const widget is built once and reused, so when a parent rebuilds, the framework can skip rebuilding it.
concepts.context: marks the leading Icon as const inside a list tile

concepts.description: A stateless widget holds no mutable state of its own and is rebuilt only when its inputs change.
concepts.context: ItemTile is stateless because everything it shows comes from the item it is given
